```{r}
tar_load(transcripts)
tar_load(transcripts_html)
tar_load(transcripts_lines)
tar_load(transcripts_clean)
transcripts_lines <- open_dataset(transcripts_lines, format = "parquet")
transcripts_clean <- open_dataset(transcripts_clean, format = "parquet")
```

```{r}
test <- transcripts |> 
  pre_clean() |> 
  clean_speaker_names() |>
  remove_translations() |> 
  add_brackets() |>
  add_space() |> 
  split_transcripts() |>
  shift_italics_tags() |>
  clean_previously() |> 
  clean_scene_headings() |> 
  clean_captions() |> 
  clean_other() |> 
  pre_clean_lyrics() |> 
  arrow_table()
```

```{r}
test |> 
  collect() |> 
  assign_speaker_names() |>
  insert_sentinels() |>
  # separate_at_sentinels() |> 
  extract_speaker_note() |>
  # select(season, episode, type, transcript) |>
  # select(season, episode, type, speaker, transcript) |>
  select(season, episode, type, speaker, speaker_note, transcript) |>
  # filter(season == 3) |>
  # filter(season == 2, episode == 10) |>
  # filter_out(is.na(speaker_note)) |> 
  # filter(str_detect(transcript, "^(\\(|\\[)")) |> gt()
  # count(type)
  # peek_rows(transcript, "head in the game", fmt = "g")
  peek_rows(transcript, "^<i>.+</i>.+", fmt = "g")
  # peek_rows(transcript, ".+<i>.+</i>.*", fmt = "g")

```

```{r}
test |> 
  pre_clean_lyrics() |>
  assign_speaker_names() |>
  insert_sentinels() |>
  extract_speaker_note() |>
  select(season, episode, type, speaker, speaker_note, transcript) |>
  peek_rows(transcript, "^<i>.+</i>\\s[A-Z0-9]", fmt = "g")
```
